tagline: Come for a hand. Stay for another.

home.welcome_title: Welcome to the UVA Mahjong Club!
home.welcome: Come to learn, play, and just hang out, whether you’re studying, socializing, or just vibing, there’s a seat for you at the table. Grab your friends and join us for a relaxing (and maybe a little competitive 👀) mahjong session!
home.photos_pending: More club photos on the way.

about.intro: A few good hands, a few new friends, and always room for another player.
about.game: Fuzhounese (Fuzhou-style) mahjong is one of our main games: sixteen tiles in hand, four players around the table, and a gold wildcard to keep you guessing.
about.variety: Other styles are welcome too. Bring your house rules; we’ll learn together.
about.other_styles: You might know Japanese riichi or Hong Kong-style mahjong, each with its own scoring traditions. American mahjong uses jokers and a card of winning hands.
